observed_defect: Flat prairie lacks rolling asymmetry and strategic visual depth
design_intent: Create broad, gentle, asymmetric hills and valleys visible from strategic camera, preserving city pad and outer border
expected_visual_difference: Visible terrain undulations with natural slopes and valleys, no towers or platforms
mobile_risks: No high-poly clusters, no material replacement, no platforming

actions.reason: Create primary asymmetric hill silhouette by extruding 2.5m upward from center, preserving city pad edge
Create valley by inset 1.2m inward from hill crest, preserving outer border
Smooth hill transition with 0.3m bevel radius for mobile performance and visual softness
Apply unified prairie material with subtle height variation for terrain depth

params.material: ZoneOne textured prairie and integrated scar
